comments.author: home
comments.text: 2026-11-11: limits read. Lambda concurrency was 10, far too low for a Papyrus backend; an increase to 1000 is requested and PENDING with AWS. Amplify: 25 apps. CloudFront: 500 distributions. Mail sending is still in the sandbox (200 a day), tracked in HUM-bdd767.

comments.text: 2026-11-11 later: AWS opened a case for the Lambda limit (status CASE_OPENED, desired 1000). Check it before the first backend deploy.
